slides.teacher_cue: New sound — long /iː/. Two spellings: ee (see, tree, feet) and ea (eat, read, team). Both make the same long vowel sound. Note for students: this is the sound at the end of he, me, she, we — now you know why those words end with an /iː/ sound. Their spelling uses a lone e, which we will learn more about later.
slides.expected_response: Students produce long /iː/ cleanly and understand that ee and ea both spell this sound.
slides.correction_move: Model the contrast: short /ɪ/ (sit) vs long /iː/ (seat). Students alternate. Then show ee and ea as both representing /iː/.
slides.observation_note: Watch for short /ɪ/ substitution — the key Korean interference pair this lesson.

slides.teacher_cue: Say see — to use your eyes. ee spelling. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say see orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model see orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /iː/ — not short /ɪ/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say tree — a large plant. tr onset, ee at the end. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say tree orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model tree orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /l/ on /r/ in onset and long /iː/ at the end.

slides.teacher_cue: Point to your feet. Say feet — ee in the middle. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say feet orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model feet orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and long /iː/ in the vowel team.

slides.teacher_cue: Mime eating. Say eat — ea spelling this time. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say eat orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model eat orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the ea spelling contrast with ee — same sound.

slides.teacher_cue: Say team — a group working together. ea in the middle. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say team orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model team orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /iː/ in ea and for the short /e/ contrast.

slides.teacher_cue: Say clean — not dirty. cl onset, ea vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say clean orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model clean orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for cl onset — /l/ vs /r/ still active — and long /iː/ in ea.
